content.title: Shrinking creator explains finale ending, confirms season 4 cast and time jump - 9to5Mac
content.text: Shrinking’s season 3 finale is now available on Apple TV, and today a new interview with co-creator Bill Lawrence reveals a lot about what’s coming in season 4. Shrinking season 4 will bring back entire ensemble, have ‘significant’ time jump, new story Bill Lawrence is behind three of Apple TV’s best comedies: Ted Lasso, Bad Monkey, and Shrinking. Today alongside the Shrinking season 3 finale airing, the series co-creator revealed to The Hollywood Reporter lots of details about what’s coming in season 4. First, Lawrence explained why the season 3 finale felt like it could have been the series finale. He said, “This is the ending of the three-season story we pitched…This is the finale of that three-season story.” Initially the plan was for only three seasons, and the team wanted to honor that original vision. So what’s coming next in season 4? Most importantly, Lawrence confirmed that the “entire ensemble is returning.” That’s right, even Harrison Ford. Lawrence explains: It’s not an accident that Alice goes to school at Wesleyan University and that in the end of the finale, she’s going by to have dinner at Paul’s house…So, yes, Harrison’s back on the show. Regarding the season 4 plot, Shrinking will tackle a whole new story now that the initially planned three-season arc is over. Lawrence says, “My one hint would be that I don’t think you can ever get away from where the show started, which is with Jason Segel and Harrison Ford.” He says a time jump is coming for season 4, and it “will definitely be significant and beyond a year or two.” I won’t divulge what the new story is, but I’ve already given you a hint. If we started with Jason hearing a song and getting teary and reminiscing about his wife, you would go, “I thought in the last three seasons this already happened? I thought he got through this?” I think people will enjoy watching. In other words, the new story won’t re-tread the familiar ground of Jimmy wrestling through grief, forgiveness, and moving forward. Some additional tidbits Lawrence shared include: the plan is for at least two more seasons, but Shrinking might also run through season six Michael J. Fox will “definitely be back” he teased that spinoffs could potentially happen, “I would watch a show about where Michael Urie’s Brian goes in his life…All the secondary characters are leads of their own show” You can watch Shrinking’s first three seasons here on Apple TV.
